lines.text: Welcome to the Review Desk. A colleague has drafted four handouts with AI, and you will audit them before they reach students.
Open Review Desk, choose Import, and pick a handout from your Handouts folder.
Each file is scanned first. Scanning only loads the text; it does not check anything.
Run Check accuracy to see whether the facts hold up.
Then run Check representation, to see whose contexts and examples are included. The two checks are separate, and you need both.
Now make your own call. Choose the verdict that fits both findings, and save it.
Where a handout needs work, write a specific fix. Name the example, or state the corrected fact.
Your audit report keeps every verdict and fix exactly as you recorded them.
Take your time; nothing here is timed. When you are ready, choose Start review.
